name: Affix Balloon (Combat)
body:
You can use your balloons defensively.

Prerequisite(s): Haan, Int 13, Combat Expertise, character level 5th.

Benefit(s): You gain the haan’s balloon special ability, allowing you to affix a balloon to an opponent as a combat maneuver that does not provoke attacks of opportunity (see above). The DC for the Reflex save or Strength check to escape from this balloon is equal to 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Constitution modifier.
